Definition: neuter plural of G3588 and G846 as adverb; in the same way:--even thus, (manner) like, so.
BiblicalUsage: The word means in the same way, even thus, like. Jesus says, Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed, and Paul says the Thessalonians suffered like things of their own countrymen, even as the churches in Judaea suffered of the Jews. It is found in the older Greek text; the newer text reads the two words separately.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even thus is a warning and a comfort together: as it was, so it shall be.
